turns.question: Which call topic had the highest objection rate in September 2026, and what was that rate?
turns.answer: Among topics with a computed rate, returns had the highest objection rate in September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30) at 72.7% (product was 50.0%; delivery and pricing returned no rate), and this is model-derived from labels by gemini-3.5-flash under prompt v1. Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
